```{r}
input <- readLines("mults")
```

```{r}
mul <- function(x, y) {
  return(x*y)
}
```

```{r}
input %>% 
  str_remove_all(pattern = "don't\\(\\).*?do\\(\\)") %>% 
  str_extract_all(pattern = "mul\\(\\d{1,3},\\d{1,3}\\)") %>% 
  unlist() %>% 
  parse(text = .) %>%
  map(eval) %>% 
  unlist() %>% 
  sum()
```
